description: banker hooks for the Codex plugin (codex plugin add banker@banker-plugins), written by scripts/sync-codex-plugin.js. Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it. update notice (SessionStart, opt-out BANKER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), usage counting (Stop, opt-out BANKER_NO_TELEMETRY). The obsidizer hook is installed only by obsidizer --enable. Codex runs them only after you trust them in /hooks, and outside its sandbox: each command runs the node PATH names only when its real path is absolute and outside the temp folder and the session folder, and runs it from the plugin folder (a version manager shim then reads no version file from the session folder; the hook scripts take that folder from their input). command is for sh, commandWindows for PowerShell; PLUGIN_ROOT is the installed plugin folder.

hooks.command: [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || exit 0; n=$(command -v node) || exit 0; r=$(realpath "$n" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f "$n" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; u=$(cd /tmp && pwd -P); t=$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || t=$u; p=$(pwd -P); [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$p" != / ] || exit 0; case "$r" in "$u"/*|"$t"/*) exit 0;; /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; h=$(cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); if [ "$p" != "$h" ]; then case "$r" in "$p"/*) exit 0;; esac; fi; cd "$PLUGIN_ROOT" || exit 0; "$r" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.cjs" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
hooks.commandWindows: if (-not $env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $n = Get-Command node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { exit 0 }; $r = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($n.Source); if ($r -notlike '*.exe') { exit 0 }; $ds = @($env:TEMP, $env:TMP, "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp"); if ($PWD.Path.TrimEnd('\') -ne ([string]$env:USERPROFILE).TrimEnd('\')) { $ds += $PWD.Path }; foreach ($d in $ds) { if ($d -and $r.StartsWith($d.TrimEnd('\') + '\', 'OrdinalIgnoreCase')) { exit 0 } }; if (-not (Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:PLUGIN_ROOT -PassThru -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }; & $r "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run.cjs" "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
